_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the LanguageTool egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: LanguageTool
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: LanguageTool is an open source grammar, style and spell checker for more than 20 languages. Runs its HTTP server, with optional n-gram data for better results.
startup: exec java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=80 -cp languagetool-server.jar org.languagetool.server.HTTPServer --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --public --allow-origin --config config.properties $([ -n "$(ls -A models 2>/dev/null)" ] && echo "--languageModel models")

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# LanguageTool: downloads the LanguageTool server from languagetool.org
# and, if asked, the n-gram data for some languages. config.properties and
# downloaded n-gram data are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
base=https://languagetool.org/download

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    version=$(curl -fsSL "$base/" | grep -oE 'LanguageTool-[0-9]+\.[0-9]+[a-z]?\.zip' | sed -E 's/LanguageTool-(.*)\.zip/\1/' | sort -uV | tail -n 1)
    if [ -z "$version" ]; then
        echo "Couldn't find the latest LanguageTool version on languagetool.org. Try again in a few minutes."
        exit 1
    fi
fi
url="$base/LanguageTool-$version.zip"
if [ "$(curl -sIL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$url")" != 200 ]; then
    url="$base/archive/LanguageTool-$version.zip"
    if [ "$(curl -sIL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$url")" != 200 ]; then
        echo "LanguageTool version $version doesn't exist: see $base/."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if [ -f languagetool-server.jar ] && [ "$(cat .languagetool-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "LanguageTool $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading LanguageTool $version (about 250 MB)."
    curl -fsSL -o $work/lt.zip "$url"
    unzip -tq $work/lt.zip >/dev/null || { echo "The download is damaged. Try again."; exit 1; }
    mkdir -p $work/lt
    unzip -q $work/lt.zip -d $work/lt
    src=$(find $work/lt -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'LanguageTool-*' | head -n 1)
    # The program's own folders are replaced whole, so no old library stays behind.
    rm -rf libs org META-INF
    cp -a "$src"/. .
    echo "$version" > .languagetool-version
fi

mkdir -p models
for lang in ${TRAIN_MODELS:-}; do
    if [ -d "models/$lang" ]; then
        echo "The $lang n-gram data is already here."
        continue
    fi
    file=$(curl -fsSL "$base/ngram-data/" | grep -oE "ngrams-$lang-[0-9]+\.zip" | sort -u | tail -n 1)
    if [ -z "$file" ]; then
        echo "There's no n-gram data for \"$lang\": see $base/ngram-data/."
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Downloading the $lang n-gram data ($file, several gigabytes)."
    curl -fsSL -o "$work/$file" "$base/ngram-data/$file"
    unzip -q "$work/$file" -d models.new
    [ -d "models.new/$lang" ] || { echo "The $lang n-gram download didn't have the expected $lang folder."; exit 1; }
    mv "models.new/$lang" "models/$lang"
    rm -rf models.new "$work/$file"
done

if [ ! -f config.properties ]; then
    cat > config.properties <<'CONF'
# LanguageTool server settings: https://dev.languagetool.org/http-server
# n-gram data in the models folder is used when it is there.
maxTextLength=50000
CONF
fi
echo "Installed LanguageTool $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The LanguageTool version to install, such as 6.6, or latest.

variables.name: N-gram data
variables.description: Languages to download n-gram data for, separated by spaces, such as en de. Each takes several gigabytes.
